notes.title: Massive Update — Many Improvements
notes.content:
After many weeks of development, we've published a grand update to [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/i]. The main improvements are:

[list]
[*] A Spanish translation has been added.
[*] We made huge improvements to the Japanese and Chinese translation of the game.
[*] We improved lots of background art in Rika's ending.
[*] We replaced the majority of AI art placeholders that remained in the game.
[/list]

Now, let us drink,

Cheers, lain

leaves

notes.title: Achievements and Bad Endings Added
notes.content:
We have just published the following changes to [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/i]:

[list]
[*] 13 Achievements have been implemented.
[*] 5 bad endings have been added.
[*] A number of placeholder artworks have been replaced.
[*] We did an extensive script workthrough, improving countless scenes.
[/list] 

This is a last update before the full release of the game that will take place later this month.

Please let us know if you experience any issues with the current build of the game.

Cheers,
lain

notes.title: Major Update Released!
notes.content:
We're just done releasing the second major update to [b]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/b]. 

This update includes all ending routes and the 3 main good endings to the game, making it about 98% complete content wise. Only the bad endings are missing.

We will need about 4 to 8 weeks to finalize the game. This includes:
- adding all five bad endings
- improving and replacing placeholder artwork
- full script workthrough
- rewrite of select scenes
- general polishing and improvement

The current plan is to have the full release out in May (or June) 2024.

Thank you for all your feedback and for playing our games!

Cheers,
lain

leaves

notes.title: Big Update to Early Access Version!
notes.content:
We'd like to announce a huge update to the early access version of [i]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead![/i]

This update finalizes the base section of the game, and adds the majority of the Marisa/Ina ending route. With this update, the game is about 70% done.

I'd like to thank you all for your patience. This update was long overdue. We hope to publish our next update early January 2024, bringing the game to about 95% completion.

Cheers,
lain

leaves

notes.title: Large update coming soon!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. We'll be publishing a big update to [b]Deluge: Sermon for the Dead[/b] somewhere around Halloween.

As you may have noticed, the game has become delayed. This is mainly due to the size of the project. When we set out developing, we assumed this would be a 6-8 hour game — but now that we have fully worked out the different routes and plotlines, it will likely be closer to 10-15 hours. As we don't want to rush this game, we've decided to push forward our deadline to early 2024.

We'll be adding about 4 hours of gameplay soon, please stay posted,

Cheers,

lain
Leaves
